prompt: Who was the most recent Sheriff of Los Angeles County killed in the line of duty?
answer:
The most recent **Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department deputy killed in the line of duty was Deputy Sheriff Ryan Clinkunbroomer**. He was ambushed and fatally shot while on duty near the Palmdale Sheriff’s Station on **September 16, 2023**.

Deputy **Ira Ynigo**, who died in an off-duty traffic collision on October 13, 2026, was not killed in the line of duty.
